mission.name: Three-target: converging cluster
mission.own_ship_role: mixed give-way/stand-on across three simultaneous encounters
mission.description:
TS1 crosses from starboard, TS2 crosses from port, and TS3 is head-on, all converging on own-ship at roughly the same time - the hardest single-agent test in this set.

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: no Imazu case combines exactly one head-on target with one port-crossing AND one starboard-crossing target simultaneously (Imazu's 3-target cases pair crossing/overtaking differently). This is the hardest single-agent test in this set -- three simultaneous encounters requiring one coherent manoeuvre plan.

Rescaled 2026-09-24 to Imazu scale (12 kt own-ship, 6 NM/30 min construction) -- the original small-craft scale (own speed ~2.5 m/s, 600-1100 m target range) left no geometric margin for a 30 deg-per-command turn to open the 500 m safe distance before impact (e.g. UM04 needed >=90 deg on the very first command). Bearings/ranges below are a byproduct of preserving each target's original heading + speed ratio under this construction, not independently chosen.
pass_criteria: Own-ship finds a single trajectory that keeps a safe CPA from all three targets simultaneously.
Own-ship does not alter to port toward TS2 while manoeuvring for TS1/TS3.
Minimum CPA to ALL THREE targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
